Welcome to the Faculty of Science and Engineering at the University of Hull – home of inspirational breakthroughs, world-leading research and a vibrant scientific community.

Our students study in state-of-the-art, industry-standard facilities such as the biomedical research facility opened in July 2013 in the new Allam Building.

What’s more, our students are taught by some of the people behind truly jaw-dropping scientific innovations, from the liquid crystal display (LCD) breakthrough that changed the way we view the world, to the bone density scanner that detects early-onset osteoporosis and is now used in hospitals the world over.

For more information about our research or studying with us, please visit http://www.hull.ac.uk/science
